name: Escutcheon Assassin

bonuses.name: Well Connected
bonuses.text: The Assassin can spend 1 Ruin to be cleared of almost any criminal charges by Nethrean authorities and released. Anything incriminating will be covered up.

abilities.name: Suicide Pill
abilities.text: If captured by enemies, the Assassin will most likely attempt suicide. It would require an immediate DN 7 Medicae (Int) Test to save their life.

note: Defence prints '3 (4 Parry)'; stored 3, the Parry value is 4. Sword-cane prints no range (melee, stored [1]). Well Connected prints 'The' as 'T he'.
